name: scholar-mcp
description: Multi-source academic search, citation graphs, paper reading, and deep research workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Search papers and trace academic evidence.
interface.longDescription: Search and rerank academic literature across multiple sources, follow citations and references, build paper graphs, read open-access papers, and run evidence-grounded deep research workflows.
defaultPrompt: Map the recent literature and key paper lineages for this topic.
Verify this technical claim against primary academic sources.
Find the strongest papers, counterevidence, and open questions.
